Method of Attack: Encrypts data files using AES encryption and demands ransom in Bitcoin
Installed by attacker brute forcing weak passwords on Remote Desktop or Terminal Services
Generates encryption keys, encrypts data files, uploads files to hacker's temp folder via terminal services client drive mapping
Scans all mapped drives including removable and network drives for targeted file extensions to encrypt
Adds 'oorr.' string to beginning of encrypted file names
Leaves ransom note file 'help recover files.txt' with instructions and changing ransom emails
Deletes created files and clears Application, Security, and System event logs to hinder forensics
Impacted Systems: Computers running Remote Desktop or Terminal Services
Attack Vector: Brute force of weak passwords on Remote Desktop or Terminal Services
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note file titled 'help recover files.txt'
Use of terminal services client drive mapping path \\tsclient\c\temp\
Commands executed to clear event logs: wevtutil.exe cl Application, wevtutil.exe cl Security, wevtutil.exe cl System
